column1: # Every file in forge-gui-campaign/ that shadows (replaces on the classpath) an upstream file.
# scripts/check_shadows.py hashes each upstream original at the pinned commit and fails the
# build if it no longer matches: that means upstream changed it and our copy must be re-ported.
# Columns (tab-separated): our file, upstream (forge|neo), upstream path, sha256 of the original we copied.
